reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two distinct mechanisms—moderately negative lattice misfit at multilayer interfaces (from P2, P5 on γ/γ′ in HESAs) and serrated/engineered grain boundary creep resistance (from P15, P20, P29, P32)—and applies them to a new context of multilayer coatings, linking them through the intrinsic lattice distortion of HEAs (P35, P41, P42). None of the passages proposes this specific combination for multilayer coatings, nor do they explicitly connect misfit engineering at artificial interfaces with the intrinsic chemical disorder to suppress dislocation climb and glide in a coating architecture.
